```yaml
---
id: vuln-mpxj-80028028
languages:
  - java
message: Potential Zip Slip vulnerability in InputStreamHelper.processZipStream
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-49771
  cwe: CWE-22
pattern: |
  $X = new File($A, $B);
  -$X.getCanonicalPath().startsWith($A.getCanonicalPath() + File.separator)
...
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerability where the canonical path of the file being created is not within the directory specified. This is a common vulnerability known as Zip Slip, which allows an attacker to traverse outside of the intended directory structure. The rule is written in YAML format and is designed to detect the pattern where the canonical path of the file being created is not within the directory specified. The rule is set to have a severity of ERROR, which means it will be flagged as a potential issue in the code.
